It reports that BAS-2 scores were significantly correlated with various constructs, including a negative correlation with BMI, as referenced in an unprovided Table 1. Hierarchical regression analyses were performed to assess incremental validity for self-esteem and optimistic life orientation, with BAS-2 scores showing significant incremental contributions.
